description.value: BC Liquor Store (store #59) is a provincial government-run BCLIQUOR retail outlet in Sidney, BC, offering wine, spirits, beer, coolers, and ciders. The chain operates 198 stores across British Columbia and serves over 36 million customers annually. Cyclists passing through Sidney could stop here for beverage resupply, though the store does not appear to offer dedicated cyclist services.
